title: Activity Registry YAML
description: Schema for an activity registry: the hand-written file listing a publication's activities under stable keys, reconciled by `novedu codes sync`.

base-url.description: Base URL each entry's `file` is resolved against. Must end with a slash. Only needed when an entry uses `file`.

quizzes.description: Activities minted as `quiz` codes, keyed by the name your material references.

tutors.description: Activities minted as `tutor` codes, keyed by the name your material references.

writing.description: Activities minted as `writing` codes, keyed by the name your material references.

coding.description: Activities minted as `coding` codes, keyed by the name your material references.

cloze.description: Activities minted as `cloze` codes, keyed by the name your material references.

activities.description: The activities, grouped by the kind of code each one is minted as.

file.description: Path to the activity YAML, resolved against `base-url`. Give exactly one of `file` or `url`.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the activity YAML. Give exactly one of `file` or `url`.

start.description: Start of the code's validity window, ISO 8601 with an explicit offset or Z (e.g. 2026-09-01T08:00:00+02:00), whole seconds.

end.description: End of the code's validity window, same format as `start`, and must be after it.

note.description: Note shown in the codes list, at most 200 characters. No effect on behaviour.

llm.description: Per-code LLM override replacing the activity YAML's own `llm:`. Provider and model must be given together; `reasoning` is optional on top of them.

provider.description: LLM provider override for this code. Required when `llm` is present.

model.description: Model id (for Azure Foundry, the deployment name). Required when `llm` is present.

reasoning.description: Optional reasoning effort for reasoning models, applied on top of the provider/model pair. Omit to let the model decide.

registryEntry.description: One activity: where its YAML lives, plus the parameters its code is minted with.
